@graph.headline: Best Home Builder Websites: Examples and Evaluation Criteria
@graph.description: Evaluate the best home builder websites by buyer fit, project proof, process clarity, accessibility, performance, and conversion, not appearance alone.

mainEntity.name: What makes a home builder website one of the best?

acceptedAnswer.text: It helps the right buyer identify fit, understand the process, evaluate credible project proof, meet the team, and take a clear next step while remaining usable, accessible, and technically sound.

mainEntity.name: Should a builder website lead with a video or a photo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the medium that shows the work clearly without delaying or blocking the page's main job. Test mobile loading, controls, motion preferences, captions, image quality, and the visibility of the core message.

mainEntity.name: How many projects should a builder website show?

acceptedAnswer.text: Show enough approved projects to represent the work the builder wants more of. Curate for relevance and context rather than publishing every available image.

mainEntity.name: Can an automated score identify the best builder website?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Automated tools can find some technical and accessibility issues, but evaluation also requires human review of fit, proof, process, usability, content, and the complete conversion path.

mainEntity.name: Should builders copy a website example they like?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Use examples to identify useful patterns, then design around the builder's own audience, positioning, proof, content, operations, and technical requirements.
